_about: WORDS TWO, HIS HOMEWORK, SHEET TWO: SCARY, THEN WHAT (VAMILY rules 455, 454(c); ask rows 637, 629). Twelve cards, one screen of the tab. Each card tests ONE second word of his law on ONE mouth, and no mouth of sheet one that he has already answered is asked the same thing twice. tools/bohemia_words_two_homework.js reads every line out of the named file; nothing here is a line. No rewrite of ours rides on any card.
said: There's two words, but the first word is always scary, and whatever emotion you're trying to get out of people, the second one follows that

cards.who_plain: A girl running a toll with a shopping cart
cards.when: her crew blocks the road and she names the price
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: SCARY FUNNY on the road: a hold-up told as a joke about clothes, with a runway name in it; is the joke allowed to lead, and do the fashion names belong in a mouth

cards.who_plain: A man at the pump house
cards.when: you come back after you killed the boss who owned the water
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card after a boss falls
cards.teaches: SCARY HAPPY: the best news the game has (a boss dead, the water back); how does joy sound from somebody still in hell

cards.role: the man who walks beside you
cards.who_plain: Your second, the man who walks beside you
cards.when: one of your men is struck down and does not get up
cards.where: on the MAP, on the small face plate after a fight
cards.teaches: SCARY SERIOUS: telling the boss a man is dead, in seven words with one Spanish word in it; the heaviest news his own crew gives him

cards.role: the Mob's man at the fight pit
cards.who_plain: The bookie at the fight pit
cards.when: you walk up to see who your men would fight tonight
cards.where: in a TOWN with a pit, at the bookie
cards.teaches: SCARY CONFIDENT: a man who is not afraid of you at all, selling you a fight; the last four words are the scary part

cards.when: they call their street to a meeting
cards.teaches: SCARY TRYING TO BE A LEADER, on the feed: neighbours with flashlights calling themselves a watch; how does somebody sound who is trying to be in charge and is not sure he is

cards.mouth: A SIDE QUEST ON THE ROAD
cards.role: with forty people outside a raided town's gate; a week ago they were three hundred
cards.who_plain: An old woman leading the forty people left of a town
cards.when: you tell her they can come and stand on your block
cards.where: on the MAP, on a side quest's card
cards.teaches: SCARY POLITICAL: she takes his help and tells him in the same breath that she will want a say; power talked about out loud by somebody with nothing

cards.when: you bring your hurt men in
cards.where: in a TOWN, at the clinic
cards.teaches: SCARY KIND: the one person whose job is to help, and the price is in the middle of the sentence; his law says nobody helps out of kindness and everybody says so

cards.role: about his own old wound, on his card
cards.who_plain: One of your men, about his own old wound
cards.when: you open his card on the crew screen
cards.where: on the crew screen, on his card
cards.teaches: SCARY PROUD: a man bragging about nearly dying; two short sentences and a punchline, the shape the research found everywhere

cards.when: a sister needs medicine and there is none
cards.teaches: SCARY BEGGING, typed: a plea on the feed with no offer in it; his kid on the road offered work, so does a post have to offer something too

cards.who_plain: A woman selling designer clothes off a rack
cards.when: you walk past her rack in the road
cards.where: on the MAP, on the card that stops your crew on the road
cards.teaches: SCARY SELLING: a sales pitch that insults him first; 'you live forever' is the only scary thing in it and it is a joke

cards.when: you win a fight and one of your men died in it
cards.where: on the screen after a FIGHT
cards.teaches: SCARY SAD: grief from a seventeen-year-old, and the one line in the fight that says 'like' the way a person does

cards.when: another of your men drank his water in the night
cards.where: on the MAP, on a card at the night stop
cards.teaches: SCARY ANGRY: a fight over water inside his own crew, said in a full careful sentence ('unless you tell me why I should not')
